releaseBasis: Native-source review and explicit incremental-release decision; not a qualified automatic pronunciation method

selection.order: Prefer MV3 then FV3 for complete component agreement; otherwise prefer non-disputed matching observations, then no accepted disagreement
selection.gou1: FV3 selected; MV3 final disagrees with the checker, retained in private research for diagnosis
selection.audioProcessing: Unchanged original MP3 bytes; filenames changed only

automaticVerification.method: Two temporal component heads plus two physical-pitch tone classifiers; source-speaker normalization; predicted-label confidence floors
limitations: Trained partly on MSU speakers; higher MSU agreement does not establish unbiased superiority over other sources.
MSU FV3/MV3 selection candidates were excluded from fitting but explored during calibration.
Component agreement is not a probability of correctness or universal accuracy.
No child-speech scoring, neutral-tone or connected-speech certification.
automaticVerification.priorAttempts: Earlier V3 actual curriculum and independent external confirmation failed. Those failures remain unchanged; V4 source-conflicted training was interrupted and not used. No attempt is relabeled as passing.

comparison.currentUnsetVoiceBeforeRelease: Browser-controlled Mandarin zh-CN, variable across devices; actual output not measured as a corpus.
comparison.legacyGoogle: 841 character-keyed files; not enough filename identity for 12 listed alternate readings; no recovered source native-review evidence.
comparison.CNS11643: 557 exact-reading files; Taiwan Mandarin source remains an optional regional voice. Not wrong Mandarin and not certified as Mainland.
comparison.conclusion: MSU improves Mainland-source alignment, native-review provenance, exact-reading control and playback consistency over device/legacy Google. This is not a measured head-to-head phonetic accuracy claim.

humanReview: Additional fluent-speaker checking may resolve uncertainties and fill gaps; not a prerequisite for this source-curated release.
